compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from an app called "Make Your Song." The main function of this screen is to record your voice. The central feature is a large circular button with a square in the middle, which likely serves as the record button. 

At the top, there is a header with the app name "Make Your Song" and a "Menu" option. Below the record button, there are instructions for the user:
1. Click the Play button to listen to the music you have mixed and to create your lyrics and melody.
2. Click the Microphone button to record your voice over the music you have chosen.

There is also an advertisement banner at the bottom of the screen. The status bar at the top shows various icons, including the time (9:05), battery status, and connectivity indicators.
